remarks: Nestled on a picturesque one-acre property along a quiet street in New Canaan's sought-after Old Studio Road, this lovingly maintained single-owner home is a truly special property filled with warmth, character, and timeless charm. Owned and cherished by the same family since 1965, the home offers the rare combination of an idyllic setting, unbeatable location, and a layout ready to be enjoyed for years to come. The interior includes over 4,000 finished square feet, with 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, a sunken family room, heated sunroom, and three separate multipurpose rooms perfect for guests, office space, and study. The home was lovingly maintained and expanded over time. Outside, the stunning flat yard is the heart of the home, perfect for football games, backyard gatherings, bocce ball, or simply enjoying peaceful afternoons surrounded by mature landscaping, vintage berry bushes, and apple trees. Walking distance to town, schools, and Waveny Park, enjoy an unmatched New Canaan lifestyle steps to everyday conveniences and treasured community traditions, including the upcoming annual Fourth of July fireworks. A quick car ride to Metro North train stations and the Merritt Parkway makes this home a commuter's dream. Rarely does an in-town property combine such history with a large, private setting, making this home one to be cherished for generations to come.
